entities.name: Suzuki coupling of aryl boronic acid and iodophenol
observations: The standardized transformation couples 3-acetylphenylboronic acid with iodophenol to form an acetyl-substituted hydroxybiphenyl.
The aryl C–B and aryl C–I bonds are replaced by a biaryl C–C bond; the ketone and phenolic OH are retained.

entities.name: Pd Suzuki fluoride acetate system
observations: Close reaction records support a Pd(II) catalyst, often with a bulky phosphine ligand, potassium fluoride, acetate base, and THF or related ether solvent.

entities.name: Pd Suzuki carbonate system
observations: A second supported pattern uses a Pd–phosphine catalyst with sodium carbonate or related inorganic carbonate in ethanol/glyme or another polar ether/alcohol medium.
